Only one Villager can work each Farm.|''Age of Empires IV'' description}} The '''Farm''' is an economic [[Building (Age of Empires IV)|building]] in [[Age of Empires IV]]. It provides infinite food when harvested by [[Villager (Age of Empires IV)|Villagers]]. Farms are available to all civilizations except the [[Byzantines (Age of Empires IV)|Byzantines]], [[Mongols (Age of Empires IV)|Mongols]] and [[Golden Horde]]. The Byzantines receive a variant of the Farm called the [[Olive Grove]], which also provides [[Olive Oil]]. The Golden Horde has the [[Stockyard]], which essentially acts like a Farm that can be worked on by 4 Villagers at once. The Mongols do not have a Farm equivalent, and instead use the [[Pasture (Age of Empires IV)|Pasture]] as the long-term food source. == Tactics == Farms are an essential source of food for all civilizations that have them, and they are the main driver of a civilization's late-game economy. Because of their upfront wood cost, it is typically unfavorable to create them in the early game, where [[Sheep]], [[Berry Bush|Berries]], [[Deer]], and [[Boar]] provide faster food returns. In fact, many civilizations' strengths and weaknesses are centered around the period in the game known as the 'Farm transition', where free food on the map begins to run out and the player is forced to build Farms to continue gathering food. During this period, a player's vulnerability increases because they have to spend considerable resources to continue their economic growth that may detract from an attack or a defense. For example, civilizations like the English or [[Zhu Xi's Legacy]] can be considered to have smoother Farm transitions due to their cheaper Farms, as can civilizations like the [[Holy Roman Empire]] that can gradually add faster gathering Farms around an [[Aachen Chapel]]. Contrastingly, civilizations like the [[French (Age of Empires IV)|French]] or [[Delhi Sultanate]] that rely on aggressive map control while taking berries and hunt, and have no inherent Farm bonuses, will stunt their attacks considerably if they have to do an early Farm transition, which may provide an opportunity for an opponent to counterattack. == Further statistics == {{Boosts|Technologies |Size = 100 |HP = {{4icons|Court Architects}} (+30%, all except [[Macedonian Dynasty]])

They also have a faster default gather rate of {{Resources|food = 1}} per second. == Trivia == * [[Chinese (Age of Empires IV)|Chinese]] and [[Japanese (Age of Empires IV)|Japanese]] (and their variant civilizations') Farms harvest rice, instead of wheat like other civilizations. Rice regrows faster, but each field of rice yields less rice, leading to potentially longer runways. With Wheelbarrow, Chinese and Japanese farmers have higher yield than their counterparts. * In reality, only southern China can grow rice. In contrast, wheat is the dominant crop in northern China. * In reality, Japanese farmers have been growing wheat while waiting between rice harvests as far back as 715 AD. == Gallery == Farmaoe4.jpeg|Wheat Farm Bg-civ-chi-3-desk.jpg|Rice Farm AoE4 farming mechanics, tips, and civ bonuses {{Buildings List (Age of Empires IV)}} [[Category:Farms]] [[Category:Food]]
